title: Pimp My Juice – Mango Burst ICED 60ml
description:
Pimp My Juice – Mango Burst 60ml
Experience the tropical allure of Pimp My Juice’s Mango Burst vape juice—a sensational blend designed to transport you to sun-soaked beaches and exotic landscapes. Indulge in the luscious sweetness of ripe mangoes with each inhale, as the Mango Burst flavor delivers an explosion of fruity goodness. Let the vibrant taste of juicy mangoes captivate your senses and elevate your vaping escapade. Unleash the irresistible Mango Burst from Pimp My Juice for a tropical journey in every satisfying puff.
60ml Bottle
0mg Strength
PG30/VG70
